text: Managing a team is a challenging but rewarding job. Good communication is the foundation of success, so leaders should listen carefully and share information clearly. Delegation is also important because it builds trust and helps team members grow. Giving regular feedback helps people improve and feel valued. To keep motivation high, managers should recognise hard work and celebrate achievements. Finally, every team has disagreements, so leaders need to handle conflict calmly and fairly. By combining these skills, a manager can create a positive environment where everyone works well together and feels supported.
